description: Bluebird's own rules, on top of the shared preset (record 0284).
ignorePaths is Renovate's default list without its test folders, so the test database's base image in backend/tests/db/Dockerfile is kept current too.

pip-compile.description: The backend's two hashed locks. Renovate reads the pip-compile command from each lock's header, bumps the pin in the .in file, and recompiles every lock that depends on it. pipTools is the version `make lock-backend` runs, because pr.yml recompiles the locks and fails on any difference.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off. It is on by default for this manager, and it recompiles both locks to move every indirect pin to its newest release, with no seven-day wait.

pip_requirements.description: Off, because pip-compile already updates the .in files, and this manager would bump a lock's pin without recompiling its hashes.

packageRules.description: TypeScript stays on 5 in tools/api-types for as long as openapi-typescript peers on ^5.x, and on 6 in tools/eslint for as long as typescript-eslint refuses 7. A major there is the one update those packages must never take (record 0030).
